grammarFocus: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has。
title: My Family and Our Things
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目都是单选题或填空题。填空题的答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
A. My name is Li Wei. I am a student. I have a small family. We are four people: my father, my mother, my sister, and me. We live in a small house in Beijing. My father is a teacher. My mother is a nurse. My sister is a student, too. She is ten years old. I am twelve years old.

B. We have a dog. His name is Lucky. Lucky is two years old. He is brown and white. My sister and I play with Lucky every day. We have two bikes. My bike is blue. My sister's bike is red. My father has a car. His car is white. My mother has a computer. Her computer is black.

C. We are happy. We love our family. We have many books. My sister has three books. I have five books. We read books together. Our house is small but nice.

questions.explanation: 原文说“We are four people: my father, my mother, my sister, and me.”，所以是四口人。
questions.evidence: We are four people: my father, my mother, my sister, and me.

questions.prompt: 李伟的爸爸是做什么工作的？
questions.explanation: 原文说“My father is a teacher.”，所以爸爸是老师。
原文说“She is ten years old.”，所以妹妹十岁。
原文说“His name is Lucky.”，所以狗的名字是Lucky。

questions.prompt: 李伟的自行车是什么颜色的？
questions.explanation: 原文说“My bike is blue.”，所以李伟的自行车是蓝色的。

questions.prompt: 李伟的妈妈有什么？请用原文中的一个词填空：My mother has a ______.
questions.explanation: 原文说“My mother has a computer.”，所以填computer。

questions.prompt: 李伟有几本书？请用英文数字填空：I have ______ books.
questions.explanation: 原文说“I have five books.”，所以填five。

questions.prompt: 根据短文，李伟的妹妹有几本书？
questions.explanation: 原文说“My sister has three books.”，所以妹妹有三本书。

vocabulary.example: My sister is a student, too.

grammar.title: 一般现在时：have/has 与物主代词
grammar.explanation: 我们用 have 表示“有”。当主语是 I、you、we、they 时用 have；当主语是 he、she、it 时用 has。物主代词 my（我的）、your（你的）、his（他的）、her（她的）放在名词前，表示所属。
grammar.example: My father has a car. His car is white.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：She ______ a red bike.
questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，所以用 has。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：We ______ two dogs.
questions.explanation: 主语 We 是复数，所以用 have。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：This is my brother. ______ name is Tom.
questions.explanation: brother 是男性，所以用 His 表示“他的”。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：My mother has a computer. ______ computer is black.
questions.explanation: mother 是女性，所以用 Her 表示“她的”。
